module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input slowena,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
  if (reset) begin
    q <= 4'b0000;
  end else if (slowena) begin
    if (q == 4'b1001) begin
      q <= 4'b0000;
    end else begin
      q <= q + 4'b0001;
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input j,
  input k,
  output reg Q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  case ({j, k})
    2'b00: Q <= Q;            // No change
    2'b01: Q <= 1'b0;         // Reset
    2'b10: Q <= 1'b1;         // Set
    2'b11: Q <= ~Q;           // Toggle
  endcase
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input j,
  input k,
  input areset,
  output reg out
);

  always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) 
      out <= 1'b0;
    else begin
      case ({j, k})
        2'b00: out <= out;      // No change
        2'b01: out <= 1'b0;     // Reset
        2'b10: out <= 1'b1;     // Set
        2'b11: out <= ~out;     // Toggle
      endcase
    end
  end
  
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input j,
  input k,
  input reset,
  output reg out
);

  always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
    if (reset) begin
      out <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      case ({j, k})
        2'b00: out <= out;       // Hold state
        2'b01: out <= 1'b0;      // Reset state
        2'b10: out <= 1'b1;      // Set state
        2'b11: out <= ~out;      // Toggle state
        default: out <= out;
      endcase
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input a,
  input b,
  output reg q,
  output reg state
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    state <= a & b; // AND gate
    q <= state;     // q follows the state
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [3:0] a,
  input [3:0] b,
  input [3:0] c,
  input [3:0] d,
  input [3:0] e,
  output reg [3:0] q
);
  always @(*) begin
    q = ((a & b) | (c ^ d)) & e;
  end
endmodule

module TopModule (
  input  [3:0] in,
  output [3:0] out_both,
  output [3:0] out_any,
  output [3:0] out_different
);

  assign out_both = in & {4{1'b1}};          // All bits are ANDed with 1.
  assign out_any = in | {4{1'b0}};           // All bits are ORed with 0.
  assign out_different = in ^ (in >> 1);     // XOR adjacent bits.

endmodule
